verdict.rationale: GlitchTip accepts events from Sentry's open-source SDKs and says it aims to be Sentry API compatible ('anything that works with Sentry should also work with GlitchTip'). Community users confirm they use the wider Sentry reporter ecosystem, including newer SDKs like Svelte, so the 'compatible SDKs' half of the story is well supported. The evidence never shows GlitchTip documenting the ingestion protocol itself for custom clients, and OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the event-ingestion endpoint/payload format for hand-built clients, a published API/protocol spec, independent evidence of custom (non-Sentry-SDK) clients working.
